name: lidocaine + menthol + methyl salicylate
purpose: Purpose Topical Anesthetic Purpose Topical Analgesic Purpose Topical Counterirritant
otcwarn: Do not use • more than one patch on your bidy at a time or on cuts, irritated, or swollen skin • on puncture wounds • for more than one week without consulting a doctor. Stop use and ask a doctor if • conditions worsens • redness is present • irritation develops • symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days • you experience signs of injury, such as pain, swelling, or blistering where the product was applied
